name: PROTOCOL AI RAPPELING
scope: Both readable SQFs fully read. Binary startup/dependencies/licence unverified; user-declared Advanced Rappelling and CBA dependencies retained.
intent: Deliver existing helicopter cargo to a validated ground/roof insertion point, hand rope execution to provider and then resume ordinary infantry control.
existingCbe: No CBE AR_Rappel_All_Cargo executor found in production SQF. Generic aircraft/flight leases and finite actor operations are reusable foundations, not implemented rappelling.
sourceDefects: Every3s global vehicles scan, no authority/locality/Zeus/player/provider ownership contract.
Creates a new cargo group and joinSilent before deciding to insert, permanently changing mission group identity.
nearEntities600 and insideBuilding/live enemy transforms reveal knowledge; fallback nearest house is not the original objective.
Bounding-box roof centre is not a reachable safe roof/rope landing; height clamp local is not used in provider call.
doMove on pilot with repeated LIMITED, then flyInHeight setting and2s wait; distance2D<=18 is not proof of stable safe hover.

Direct AR_Rappel_All_Cargo call has no provider availability/signature validation, completion acknowledgement, cargo/rope cleanup or resume authority. buildingRappelDone marks request as success and prevents repeat use.
remaining: Real finite provider-owned rappel task and handover are not implemented. Verify installed provider API/signature, rope/cargo state and physical completion before exposing a behaviour module. Dependency detection is not a completed feature.
sourceProtection: Original PBO and extracted readable files verified against inventory hashes; no raw source copied into product.
validation: Source review, caller tracing, JSON parsing and archive/extract hash verification. No product edit or runtime test in this batch.

bulkApi.name: AR_Rappel_All_Cargo
bulkApi.finding: Vehicle-owner scheduled worker creates LOGIC leader, changes behaviour/combat/formation, waits without deadline, drives helicopter velocity every0.05s, dispatches cargo and waits for rappelling flags. Cleanup restores initial policy without newer-order receipt. Do not call as an unbounded CBE helicopter controller.

actorApi.name: AR_Rappel_From_Heli
actorApi.authority: Server reserves available AR_Get_Heli_Rappel_Points slot, sets public AR_Is_Rappelling true, spawns AR_Client_Rappel_From_Heli on actor owner through provider remote wrapper. Returns no success receipt.
actorApi.ownership: Actor worker owns movement/physics/animation and rope objects; clears AR_Is_Rappelling after rope/device cleanup, then allowDamage restoration occurs2s later. Flag clear alone is not insertion or complete provider-quiescence proof.
actorApi.variants: Same API in both installed sources. Bundle variant changes ACE-compatible device class, player ground-detach condition and localization; AI movement exit condition otherwise remains.

installedProviderApiReview.implementation: Shared CortexExternalOwner and fast CompatibilityExternalControl now refuse active/malformed AR_Is_Rappelling or AR_Units_Rappelling markers read-only. False/absent markers leave ordinary AI eligible. No provider call, flag mutation or rope destruction.
remainingRequired: Finite authenticated per-actor cargo insertion with stable CBE helicopter flight ownership; actual provider slot acceptance and physical ground/roof arrival required.
Original task/order/owner deadlines, no mission-group reassignment; cancellation must not tear down a still-active provider rope or declare early completion.
Provider cleanup overlap, normal/HC ownership and repeat/abort need runtime proof; no behaviour module until executor exists.
installedProviderApiReview.validation: 1479 tests, HEMTT/full build and source/API comparison passed; no Arma run.

flightBoundaryFollowup.finding: CortexAircraftEligible already reads declared/provider airframe ownership, but FlightLeaseAcquire/Valid fast paths checked pilot/group only. AR bulk control marks helicopter rather than pilot, allowing a CBE fast flight write between slower planner checks.
flightBoundaryFollowup.implementation: Both lease admission and fast mutation predicate now read shared CompatibilityExternalControl on airframe before lease permission. No provider-specific flags duplicated in flight layer; lease release remains exact identity only. Existing air-attack and landing/braking paths use FlightLeaseValid to stop/retire their own commands.
flightBoundaryFollowup.validation: 1479 existing tests/full HEMTT build passed; no runtime handover/performance proof.
flightBoundaryFollowup.remaining: Finite per-actor cargo insertion, stable flight ownership, provider slot/physical completion/abort and normal/HC handover remain incomplete. This is a takeover safeguard, not completed rappelling.

providerQuiescenceContract20261023.scope: Targeted actual per-actor reservation/worker/cleanup trace in both installed provider variants; original files unchanged.
observedContract: AR_Rappel_From_Heli reserves a server-local AR_Rappelling_Player_index slot and publishes actor AR_Is_Rappelling before starting the actor-owner worker. It returns no structured acceptance/completion receipt.
The server slot-retirement worker polls actor flag/death every2s, without an original task deadline. Actor flag clear does not prove the server slot has retired.
Actor worker destroys ropes/devices, clears public AR_Is_Rappelling and AR_Rappelling_Vehicle, then sleeps2s and unconditionally calls allowDamage true. The bundle variant has the same ordering.

Earlier landing/fall branches also write allowDamage true. A current true damage readback or elapsed2s after flag clear cannot prove the final scheduled worker has executed; scheduler delay and indistinguishable intervening script writes remain.
The bulk API additionally runs its own unbounded helicopter/group controller. Using it would evade CBE flight ownership and finite-operation requirements.
providerQuiescenceContract20261023.impact: Current read-only runtime-marker compatibility yields during active rope state only; it is not a complete provider-cleanup acknowledgement. No CBE rappel executor is present. Do not advertise a working insertion module or infer completed handback from flag false.
providerQuiescenceContract20261023.requiredImplementation: Retain the requested finite cargo insertion feature. Implement controlled rope execution with explicit actual-owner acceptance, original task deadline, exact mission damage baseline, completion after all cleanup, and no stale delayed writes; or use a provider API revision that supplies those guarantees. Mere dependency detection, arbitrary grace time or a wrapper around the current bulk API is insufficient. Preserve group identity, actual stable flight and ground/roof arrival requirements.
providerQuiescenceContract20261023.validation: Current source re-read and SHA256 confirmation; no runtime changes, build repetition or audit launch. Existing reference-boundary check validates final engineering notes only.
providerQuiescenceContract20261023.goalStatus: Incomplete; other offline foundation/source work remains possible. Audits paused.
